tags.effort_rationale: Small responsive-control, automatic-ordering, and selection styling refinements to the existing seasonality explorer.

objective: Keep seasonality search/sort controls horizontal, sort by selected month automatically, emphasize top/bottom five ranks, and improve selected-row styling.

evidence: 2026-11-01: npm run build -- --mode pages passed and compiled the updated responsive controls, rank treatments, and selected-row styling.
2026-11-01: scripts/planning/validate_ticket.py accepted the PRSG-173 manifest and all five scoped paths.
2026-11-01: git diff --check reported no whitespace errors for the complete ticket change set.

acceptance.description: Search and sort controls stay on a horizontal row on desktop/tablet and use available mobile width in two columns.
evidence: Controls use a non-wrapping horizontal flex row on desktop/tablet and two grid columns at mobile widths.

acceptance.description: Selecting a month defaults rows to selected-month descending; manual sorts remain and deselection returns to source order.
evidence: Month selection sets return-desc; alphabetical and opposite-return sorts remain; deselect resets a return sort to source order.

acceptance.description: Top/bottom five use rank-specific green/red gradients in ranking bars and heatmap name cells.
evidence: Rank maps style each top/bottom official sector name cell by position, and both ranking panels give ranks one through five distinct green/red gradient shades.

acceptance.description: Selected row has an outline, tinted name cell, check marker, and retained aria-pressed state.
evidence: The selected row uses an outline, name-cell tint, and visible decorative check marker; the button continues to expose aria-pressed.

acceptance.description: Pages build, scope validation, and whitespace check pass.
evidence: Pages build, scope validation for all five scoped paths, and git diff --check passed.
